name: Flash Speed Clicker⚡
desc:
⚡Welcome to Flash Speed Clicker! ⚡ To get started, press the "Mouse" button to gain speed! Use your points to gain rebirths, which will reset your size, but will also make you faster and earn speed more easily. (The game is still in early development, so please bare with us as there may be a few glitches. If you find any, feel free to use the bug report button)

Be sure to leave a 👍 & ⭐ for more updates, and join the group if you have any ideas for the game :D

(Stats save)  (If you don't grow try rejoining)
